about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS GAME

This game is a professional visual novel that offers a deep and emotional experience for the player. The story features well-developed characters with complex relationships, and branching storylines where the player’s choices affect the fate of the characters and lead to multiple different endings. Even small decisions have consequences, encouraging players to replay the game and explore different paths.

The visual design of the game is of great importance. Characters have multiple facial expressions and poses that clearly convey their emotions and reactions. Backgrounds and environments are highly detailed and aligned with the story’s atmosphere, using parallax layers and visual effects to create depth and a sense of life. Key scenes and special artwork are displayed in high quality to highlight important story moments and deliver a memorable visual experience.

The soundtrack and sound effects are synchronized with the scenes and characters’ emotions, giving players a sense of true immersion in the game world. The in-game journal system allows players to review past dialogues and choices, helping them better understand their story paths.

All game elements—from character and environment design to visual effects, sound, and storytelling—work together in harmony to create a cohesive, professional, and artistic experience. This visual novel is not just a game; it is a deep, emotional narrative experience that immerses players in a detailed and captivating world.

STORY

This is a world full of contradictions and complexities, where the laws of reality are not aligned, and at any moment, everything can change.

You can step into this unique world and witness firsthand events that teeter between reality and illusion.

The story begins when a young boy enters a new university. In this environment, he meets a variety of people—friends, rivals, and others, each hiding secrets of their own. But the peace of university life is short-lived, as strange and astonishing events soon engulf him. The boy is inadvertently drawn into other worlds, worlds that seem intertwined and unfathomable.

He doesn’t know if these passages are the result of a real wormhole or some other unknown force.

Are these journeys scientific and explainable, or is there something magical and supernatural behind them?

Amid this chaos, the boy encounters a mysterious figure in one of these worlds—a being who seems to know everything, as if aware of the past, present, and future, holding the entire map of this universe in their hands.

But the question remains:

Is this figure a savior, or part of the same dark game?

Can they help the boy, or will they lead him toward an even darker fate?

Behind all these events, there exists a mechanical and enigmatic entity: a robot of immense power that controls the entire world. No one knows who created it, or what force operates it from behind the scenes.

Rumors suggest that all these events are orchestrated by this unseen hand.

Is this robot—or its mysterious creator—the cause of all the world’s contradictions?

Are they behind every puzzle, every wormhole, every hidden secret?

Questions pile up one after another:

Will the boy find a way back?

Is he doomed to remain trapped in the endless cycles of these conflicting worlds?

Or will he uncover the secrets of Chrono Lock and finally be freed?

Please, immerse yourself fully in this story: a tale of parallel worlds, intricate mysteries, unknown wormholes, and hidden truths that are gradually revealed.

This university, these journeys, these encounters—they are all part of a destiny that has yet to be written…

FEATURES

1. Character Expressions & Sprites:

Characters have multiple facial expressions and poses that change depending on dialogue and situations, making their emotions and reactions clear and lively.

2. Visual Effects & Scene Transitions:

Includes fade-in/fade-out, shake, zoom, and particle effects, making scenes more engaging and the game environment more dynamic.

3. In-game Journal / Log:

Players can review past dialogues and choices, and track their previous story paths.

4. Character Layering:

Characters can appear in the foreground, middle, or background of a scene, creating depth.

5. Dynamic Text Display:

Dialogue text appears gradually or with special effects, enhancing the narrative experience.

CHARACTERS

Shigure:

Shigure is an 18-year-old boy who has just entered university. Unlike many of his peers, he has a strong interest in wormholes and scientific mysteries, always eager to explore unusual phenomena. His curiosity sometimes leads him into unexpected and challenging situations, but this deep passion for science and the secrets of the universe makes him a unique and compelling character. Shigure is usually calm and logical, but when it comes to uncovering truths or solving mysteries, his courage and determination shine through.

Akari:

Akari is an 18-year-old girl who, like Shigure, has a strong interest in wormholes. She is the smartest student at the university, with exceptional scientific and analytical abilities that set her apart from her peers. Akari’s intelligence, charm, and likable personality make her the most popular girl on campus, often ranking first in classes and academic activities. Despite her achievements, she is friendly and kind, able to form close relationships with others, earning admiration from both students and professors alike.

Omigo:

Omigo is a boy with orange hair and a somewhat lazy personality, often avoiding difficult tasks. However, he is very friendly and sociable, and his presence in a group always brings a sense of calm and humor. Omigo isn’t particularly interested in complex scientific matters, preferring to spend his time relaxing and hanging out with friends. Despite his apparent laziness, he can show courage and support his friends when necessary, and sometimes his simple, practical ideas help solve problems. This contrast between his laid-back nature and hidden capabilities makes Omigo a charming and popular member of the group.

Yuzuki:

Yuzuki is a simple, kind-hearted girl whose smile and friendly nature naturally draw people to her. She easily connects with others and is always willing to listen and help her friends. Yuzuki’s presence brings a sense of calm and reassurance, and many see her as a reliable and trustworthy companion.

Despite her gentle and calm personality, Yuzuki can be brave and supportive when necessary, standing up for those she cares about. She usually avoids unnecessary conflicts and complications, but she is always ready to help with an open heart, creating a warm and positive environment. This combination of simplicity, kindness, and strength when needed makes Yuzuki a beloved and cherished member among her friends.

We hope you enjoy the game.
